text: APPROVE. The extracted `NestRoute` keeps the original guard checks, decision logic and skip-ahead (`k = methodEnd - 1` matches `bodySpan.End - 1`), and the null path leaves `k` advancing by one as the old `continue` did. It also removes most of the branching from `Nest`, so that method should now be under the threshold. I could not build the project here. The one build risk I could not rule out is that `Judged?` would break `yield return judged` if `Judged` were a struct, which seems unlikely.
